name: Numeric Clock
description:
Top-bar numeric clock for GNOME Shell 45–51: DD/MM/YYYY, ISO 8601, 24-hour or 12-hour time with optional seconds, using any strftime format.

* 8 one-click presets and a live preview
* Panel icon and right-click menu: presets, copy time, preferences
* Ticks exactly on the second
* Restores the stock clock when disabled

Wayland & X11/Xorg. No network access.
